meta.title: IMF — Immobilière Mseddi Frères | Real estate developer in Sfax and Tunis
meta.description: Real estate developer for over 15 years in Sfax and Tunis. High-end residences, live availability plan, loan simulator and a secure client area.

hero.eyebrow: Approved real estate developer — Sfax & Tunis
hero.subtitle: For more than fifteen years, IMF has designed, built and delivered residences made to last: selected materials, controlled finishes, commitments kept.

intro.title: A family company with an engineer’s standards
intro.body1: Immobilière Mseddi Frères is a real estate developer based in Sfax and now active in Greater Tunis. We control the full chain: land sourcing, design with our architects, construction, sales and after-sales service.
intro.body2: That integration is what lets us hold our deadlines and our finish standards — from thermal-break aluminium joinery to bespoke dressing rooms.

featured.title: Ongoing projects
featured.subtitle: Reserve your apartment with live availability, plan by plan, floor by floor.

delivered.title: Delivered programmes
delivered.subtitle: Every delivered building is our strongest argument.

items.title: Live availability
items.body: Every apartment shows its status — available, reserved or sold — with its unit type and exact sellable area. No more back-and-forth to find out what is left.

items.title: Finishes delivered, not promised
items.body: Bespoke kitchens and dressing rooms, aluminium joinery, high-end taps, central heating: what you see in our delivered buildings is what you will receive.

items.title: Financing support
items.body: Online loan simulator, bank file preparation, FOPROLOS-eligible programmes: we support you through to signature.

items.title: Secure client area
items.body: Your payment schedule, your contract documents and site progress, available at any time from your account.

cta.title: Let’s talk about your project
cta.body: Our sales team replies within 24 working hours.

group.title: Immobilière Mseddi Frères
group.lead: A family-run developer based in Sfax, IMF has been designing and building residential programmes and venues for over fifteen years, in Sfax and in Greater Tunis.
group.story1: IMF was born of a simple conviction: a building is judged ten years after delivery, not on handover day. That is why we built the company around execution — our own teams, our own suppliers, our own controls.
group.story2: From the first Diar Al Andalous residences to Complexe Marassim, then Résidence Zéphyr and the Diar Al Yassamine development, each programme raised the bar for the next. With Résidence La Gloire in El Aouina, IMF takes a new step and settles durably in Greater Tunis.

values.title: Build quality
values.body: One finishing specification across every programme, with no adjustment variable.

values.title: Transparency
values.body: Real sellable areas, up-to-date availability, clear payment schedules, no hidden fees.

values.title: Deadlines kept
values.body: A construction schedule that is published and tracked, with progress visible in your client area.

values.title: After-sales service
values.body: Support does not stop at handover: warranties, interventions, follow-up.
